market.what: photoacid generators (PAG chemicals) sold into chip photoresists, world
market.method: reports split: $171M (GIR, PAG chemical) vs $1.5B (semi PAG, likely resist-level); bottom-up est. PAG ~5-10% of $2.6B resist market = $130-260M; used ~$200M

value.logic: keeps EU/US litho running past PFAS ban: replaces ~$200M PAG at ~1.5x price (avoids $25-60M per-material requalification spread over suppliers) = ~$0.3B/yr (est.)
value.revenue_logic: yr7: ~1.5% of PAG market (KrF / non-critical layers) via resist maker JDA + supply or 5-8% royalty = ~$3M; qualification 5-10+ yrs caps it
value.margin_logic: high-value fine chemical ($k/kg) made by toll CRO, or royalty

trend.drivers: chip resist demand (EUV, KrF fastest); EU universal PFAS restriction; 3M PFAS exit end-2025
trend.deadline: ECHA RAC/SEAC final opinion end-2026; EC decision ~2027; semi derogation likely 12-13.5 yrs

competition.notes: top 4 PAG makers hold >90%; DuPont runs a computational non-F PAG library and is commercializing non-PFAS KrF; imec program since 2023; San-Apro launched PFAS-free Ga-PAG Jun 2025

lab.synth: 3-5 step custom: new non-F superacid anion (2-3 steps) + sulfonium/iodonium metathesis; 3 variants, 5-10 g each
lab.test: acid yield by dye titration (rhodamine B / coumarin 6) + DUV/EUV contrast curves and line/space litho at a university cleanroom or imec
lab.logic: synth 10 wk + test 8 wk; synth $20k + litho/metrology tool time ~$25k (est.)

sale.gates: resist formulation 3-8 yrs; fab qualification ~10 yrs, $25-60M per material (SIA); first sale = eval lots / KrF niche
